Envelope.description:
What every list verb prints under `--json`: one object, its rows in
`entries`.

next.description: Up to three runnable commands for the same scan, most useful first.

next_cursor.description: Where the next page starts (`--cursor`); null on the last page.

scan.description: The scan the rows come from.

schema_version.description: The version of the envelope's shape.

ExcludedEntry.description: A directory the scan listed but did not enter because of an exclude.

path.description: Its absolute path, as lossy UTF-8.

Explain.description:
What `explain` says of one path: facts with their evidence, never a
verdict.

allocated_bytes.description: Bytes on disk: a directory's subtree, hard links and clones once.

apparent_bytes.description: Apparent bytes: a directory's subtree, hard links counted once.

btime.description: Its creation time, when collected and the filesystem has one.

cachedir_tag.description: Whether the directory holds a valid `CACHEDIR.TAG`.

clone_group_size.description: The members of a file's clone group; null when it is none's.

clone_members_outside.description:
Members of the clone groups under the path that lie outside it;
null where the scan recorded no clone ids.

dir_count.description: A directory's directories, itself included; null for a file.

evidence.description: Where each fact came from: tables, rules, markers, files.

file_count.description: A directory's non-directories; null for a file.

freeable_now_bytes.description: The bytes deleting the path would free now.

git.description: What git says of the path; null outside a repository.

is_clone.description:
Whether a file is a member of a clone group; null for a directory,
and where the scan recorded no clone ids (it did not count clones,
or the filesystem has none: every one but APFS).

links_outside_subtree.description: Links of the inodes under the path that lie outside it.

name_raw.description: The name's bytes in base64 when they are not UTF-8.

nlink.description: A file's link count; null for a directory.

path.description: The path, absolute, as lossy UTF-8.

regenerable_by.description: The command that regenerates a cache directory, from the rules.

handle.description:
A handle for `clean --from`: base64url of what `explain` found
(the path, its device and inode, its bytes on disk, the scan, an
expiry fifteen minutes on) and their HMAC; null where none could be
issued (the path is gone, or the key cannot be read).

ExplainGit.description: What git says of a path.

ignored.description: Whether git ignores the path, or a directory above it.

precious.description: Whether the pattern that ignores it marks it precious (`$name`).

tracked_inside.description: Whether a tracked file lies at or under the path.

ObjectEnvelope.description:
What a verb that answers with one object (`explain`, `summary`,
`query`; `schema` to come) prints under `--json`: the shared fields, the
scan it read (null when none was), and the object as `result`. `query`
says what it was asked in a block of its own.

next.description: Up to three runnable commands, most useful first.

scan.description: The saved scan the answer comes from; null when none holds the path.

schema_version.description: The version of the envelope's shape.

ObjectQuery.description: What a one-object verb was asked.

path.description: The path it was asked about, absolute.

QueryBlock.description: What a list verb was asked.

limit.description: `--limit`; null when every row is returned (`--format ndjson`).

path.description: The path the rows are under, absolute.

device_confined.description: Whether the scan stayed on the root's filesystem (`-x`).

error_count.description:
Directories that could not be read, and entries listed but not
read.

excluded.description: Each directory the excludes kept the scan out of, path bytewise.

excluded_count.description:
Files left out and directories not entered by the excludes
(`--exclude`, `--exclude-from`, `--ignore-from`, `--exclude-caches`).

fs_type.description:
The root volume's filesystem type; null when the scan recorded no
volume.

id.description: The saved scan's id; null for a scan that was not saved.

incremental.description: Whether the scan reused an earlier one (never before phase 5).

root.description: The root, absolute, symbolic links resolved.

root_as_given.description: The root as the command line gave it.

size_kind.description:
The size the rows are ranked and shown by: `allocated` or
`apparent`.

total_allocated_bytes.description: Bytes on disk, hard links and clones counted once.

total_apparent_bytes.description: Apparent bytes, hard links counted once.

vanished_count.description: Entries that disappeared during the scan.

volumes.description: Every volume the scan met, entered or not.

ScanErrorEntry.description:
A directory or entry a scan could not read, as `explain --errors` lists
it.

kind.description:
`directory` (listed but not read) or `entry` (listed but not
examined).

path.description: Its path, absolute, as lossy UTF-8.

Tool.description: The program that wrote an envelope.

free_bytes.description: Bytes an unprivileged user can still write.

reason.description: Why not (`one_file_system`, `network`, …); null when it did.

code.description: One of the conventions' warning codes.

count.description: How many things it is about, where that applies.

hint.description: One imperative sentence naming a command.
